# weft_config (Data Source)

Reads the weft HCL config directory and returns the resolved list of VMs.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# weft_config parses the weft HCL config directory (same format as
# state/hcl) and returns a fully-resolved list of VMs, suitable for
# driving weft_instance resources with for_each — without duplicating
# the configuration in both HCL flavours.
data "weft_config" "weft" {
  config_dir = "state/hcl"
}

resource "weft_instance" "vms" {
  for_each = { for vm in data.weft_config.weft.vms : vm.name => vm }
  name     = each.key
  cpu      = each.value.cpu
  mem      = each.value.mem

  disk {
    from = each.value.image
    size = each.value.disk_size
  }

  ssh {
    user         = each.value.ssh_user
    keypair_path = each.value.keypair_path
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `config_dir` (String) Path to the weft HCL config directory (default "state/hcl").

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Synthetic identifier (mirrors `config_dir`).
- `vms` (Attributes List) List of VM definitions resolved from the config. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--vms))

<a id="nestedatt--vms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `vms`

Read-Only:

- `cpu` (Number) Number of vCPUs.
- `disk_gb` (Number) Boot disk size in GiB.
- `disk_size` (String) Boot disk size as string (e.g. "20Gi").
- `image` (String) Resolved image URL.
- `keypair_path` (String) Resolved path to the SSH private key file.
- `mem` (Number) Memory in GiB.
- `name` (String) Fully-qualified VM name.
- `ssh_pub_key` (String, Sensitive) Content of the SSH public key file.
- `ssh_user` (String) SSH username.
